scenarios.label: Balanced clusters
scenarios.description: Equal capacities show how integer remainders are allocated.

scenarios.label: Small-cluster caps
scenarios.description: Once small clusters fill, the remaining budget goes to other clusters.

scenarios.label: Skewed clusters
scenarios.description: Unequal capacities show the minimum allocation and small-cluster limits.

scenarios.label: Reordered clusters
scenarios.description: The same capacities as Small-cluster caps, reordered to show sorting and restoration.
